question.worked_solution:
Using the properties of addition/subtraction and scalar multiplication of vectors to isolate the $k$ term, we get

$$
\begin{aligned}6{a}_{1}+k{a}_{2} & =b \\ 6[\begin{aligned}3 \\ 1 \\ -2\end{aligned}]+k[\begin{aligned}5 \\ 3 \\ -9\end{aligned}] & =[\begin{aligned}8 \\ 0 \\ 6\end{aligned}] \\ k[\begin{aligned}5 \\ 3 \\ -9\end{aligned}] & =[\begin{aligned}8 \\ 0 \\ 6\end{aligned}]-6[\begin{aligned}3 \\ 1 \\ -2\end{aligned}] \\ k[\begin{aligned}5 \\ 3 \\ -9\end{aligned}] & =[\begin{aligned}-10 \\ -6 \\ 18\end{aligned}].\end{aligned}
$$

From the final equation above, we can tell that $k=-2.$
